mapper.select: SELECT ZYBR.pat_name xm, ZYBR.xb xb, ZYBR.sfz_hm sfzh, ZYPJ.JS_RQ jssj, ZYPJ.JS_RQ fssj, ZYBR.ybxz fylb, ML.XMDM xmbm, ML.YP_MC mc, ML.GG gg, NVL(ML.dw,F_GETYPDW(MX.SFXM_ID,MX.CD_ID,'3')) dw, CASE WHEN MI.JS_LSH IS NULL THEN '丙' ELSE CASE WHEN MX.RET_YBFL='01' THEN '甲' WHEN MX.RET_YBFL ='02' THEN '乙' WHEN MX.RET_YBFL ='03' THEN '丙' ELSE '丙' END END ybdj, MX.TS ts, MX.RET6 zfbl, '' lzje, MX.RET7 zlzfje, YS.XM ysxm, BM.BM_MC ks, ( SELECT TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(DISTINCT czd.Jb_Mc)) ZDXX FROM his.pat_inpat_diagnosis zd2 INNER JOIN dictmanage.dict_icd czd ON ZD2.ZD_ICD=CZD.ICD_CODE WHERE ZD2.ZYLSH=ZYBR.ZYLSH AND ZYPJ.ZYLSH=ZD2.ZYLSH ) jbxx FROM his.inpat_settle_invoice ZYPJ JOIN HIS.PAT_INPAT_ORDER_COST MX ON ZYPJ.JSLSH_ID=MX.JSLSH_ID AND ZYPJ.ZYLSH=MX.ZYLSH_ID left join mi_trans_info mi on ZYPJ.JSLSH_ID = mi.js_lsh and mi.mistatus in ('PAY_OK', 'RECEDE_OK', 'MI_OK') JOIN GZKBDML_MY ML ON MX.SFXM_ID=ML.YP_ID AND MX.Cd_Id=ML.Yp_Cd_Id JOIN HIS.V_INPAT_INFO ZYBR ON ZYPJ.ZYLSH=ZYBR.zylsh JOIN DICTMANAGE.DICT_EMPE YS ON MX.SQ_YSID=YS.KEYNO JOIN DICTMANAGE.DICT_DEPART BM ON MX.SQ_KSID=BM.BM_ID WHERE ((ZYPJ.zf_flag = '0' AND ZYPJ.js_zje > 0 AND ZYPJ.cjr <> '99999999') OR (ZYPJ.zf_flag = '1' and ZYPJ.js_zje > 0 and ZYPJ.cjr <> '99999999')) AND MX.FY_STATUS IN ('2','7') AND ZYPJ.JS_RQ BETWEEN to_date('2019-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AND to_date('2023-12-21 23:59:59', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') --AND ZYPJ.JSLSH_ID='1567601'
